dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: If you have any outstanding work, feel free to delegate it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I think it's beautiful here.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: It must have been quite an undertaking to decorate such a large space. Thank you for all your efforts.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: In my spare time, I particularly enjoy taking strolls outside. It's so quiet and peaceful.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Even at midday, it's perfectly safe to take a nap.

choices.text: Yes, you definitely don't need to worry about safety here...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Agreed! So I really do like it here.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Anyway, um... Thanks so much, once again!

choices.text: Take care to not catch a cold...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Please don't worry, I've slept like this every day for at least a thousand years.

choices.text: As long as you like it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Sure... but I may not be able to offer any practical advice if our topic of discussion is not work-related.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh, a—alright...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: You know, I used to agonize a lot over whether to try and integrate into human society.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: When our workload is light, my coworkers sometimes organize social events.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But my strict vegetarian diet is completely different from everyone else's. And I don't really share their interest in shopping or lively forms of entertainment.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Sometimes they can be quite critical... People say that my whole mindset is just fundamentally different from an ordinary person's...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But what can I do? It's hard to change your habits when they've been that way for thousands of years...

choices.text: I'll think of a social activity that you would find easier to accept.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Then it would only be proper for me to offer you something in return! Shall I take you out... for a meal? In a restaurant?

choices.text: We're friends, so there's no need for all that formality.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Ahh... Okay... Duly noted!

choices.text: Sounds good, I'll take the opportunity to share more knowledge with you.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Great, with your help, I'm sure I'll be able to integrate into human society in no time.

choices.text: I can go with you and help you slowly get accustomed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I thought maybe we could plant some flowers together. Or some other plants, like... vegetables...

choices.text: You must be good at gardening, huh?

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Yes, indeed... You could say it's my greatest hobby... aside from work.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Though in the past, I've been reluctant to grow vegetables... I always worried that I wouldn't be able to control my appetite and I'd end up eating them all in one sitting...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But I'm sure that if I grow them together with you, I'll definitely be able to control myself!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Even if you did eat them all, it wouldn't be such a big deal.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: No, uh... you don't understand, I...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I—I put on weight very easily, and...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: If my appearance changed, then perhaps... I—I mean, the way people see me — well, the way you see me...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh! Uh...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Still, I... I think it would be best to share them with you. You know, first rule of gardening — grow together, eat together!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: ...Anyway! I'll go, uh... fetch some seeds. I'll make sure they're the very best.

choices.text: I'll eat them with you, then.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Great! And, uh... you'll help me plant them too, right...? First rule of gardening — grow together, eat together!

choices.text: I've never seen you grow vegetables before.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: That's because... I've always feared I wouldn't be able to control my appetite, and that I'd end up eating all the vegetables I grew in one sitting...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ganyu.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Where are you off to today, is it far? My schedule is actually free right now.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Whether it's an ad-hoc assignment or any other task, I'm free to assist...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #Oh...! I forgot to say... good morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Ganyu.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #Good night to you as well, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: For once, I don't need to work overtime at night... Huh... what a strange feeling...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: That smell... the fragrance of true Liyue cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ahem... you must have put a lot of effort into finding these blueprints for Rain Calmer, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Your liking for Liyue also signifies your approval of my work... Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: A big bed and soft pillow, appropriate lighting, and even a miniature tree for embellishment...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: One can certainly rest well in a room like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I will try to finish all of my work before the sun comes up, and then... have a good sleep.
